name: matrix coupling method
domain: 车辆—轨道与基础结构动力学
definition_zh: 以矩阵关系连接子系统自由度并求解整体响应的方法。
usage_overview: 矩阵耦合方法用于将子结构及其相互作用组装为整体动力方程，使各部分响应能够联合求解。在轮轨耦合分析中，接触作用可作为系统矩阵中的关联项纳入计算。

complete_examples.text: With novelty, the tunnel components, such as rings and segments, have been coupled to the vehicle–track systems using a matrix coupling method for finite elements.
In this section, the wheel–rail matrix coupling method proposed in this paper is described in detail.
Finally, the wheel–rail matrix coupling method in Xu and Zhai (2019a) was used to connect the vehicle system and the track structure.
